hooks.command: file=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('file_path',''))" 2>/dev/null); if echo "$file" | grep -qE '\.ts$' && ! echo "$file" | grep -qE '\.spec\.ts$'; then echo "[hook] TypeScript file edited — running tsc --noEmit"; npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | tail -20; fi

file=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('file_path',''))" 2>/dev/null); if echo "$file" | grep -qE '\.ts$' && ! echo "$file" | grep -qE '\.spec\.ts$'; then echo "[hook] TypeScript file written — running tsc --noEmit"; npx tsc --noEmit 2>&1 | tail -20; fi

cmd=$(echo "$CLAUDE_TOOL_INPUT" | python3 -c "import sys,json; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print(d.get('command',''))" 2>/dev/null); if echo "$cmd" | grep -q 'HttpClient' && ! echo "$cmd" | grep -q 'HttpService'; then echo "[hook] WARNING: Direct HttpClient usage detected. Use HttpService from @core/services/http.service.ts instead."; fi

echo "
[stratum session checklist]
- [ ] npx tsc --noEmit (type-check)
- [ ] npm run build:ssr (production build)
- [ ] npm run test:headless (unit tests)
- [ ] No hardcoded URLs (all API.* constants)
- [ ] BFF routes are one-liners (no logic)
- [ ] All new routes have canActivate: [authGuard]"
